rubric.dataset_size: Reported example scale: small <1,000; medium 1,000–99,999; large >=100,000 observational units. These thresholds are an atlas convention, not thresholds stated in the manuscript figure. Always read the unit, workflow and simulation/pretraining status. Examples do not establish minimum data needs, capacity, statistical power or equal difficulty across modalities.
rubric.software_maturity: Early: research code/archive with limited reuse infrastructure. Developing: documented setup and usage, but the full mature criteria are not established. Mature: installable package, documentation/tutorials, tests and versioned releases, or an established package-registry release with documentation and registry checks. This is an engineering-evidence classification, not age, popularity, maintenance, installation success, scientific accuracy or clinical certification. No inspectable implementation: not established.
rubric.compute_demand: Documented hardware context, not a benchmark ranking: limited = CPU/ordinary-computer example; moderate = single conventional GPU or workstation example (up to 128 GB host RAM); high = explicitly recommended HPC, more than 128 GB host RAM, >=40 GB accelerator memory, or multi-accelerator configuration. A tier describes the reported example, not a minimum. CPU support alone is insufficient. Training, inference, demo and pretraining contexts are recorded separately in notes; multiple tiers can describe different workflows.
rubric.validation_evidence: Internal = evaluation by the method authors, including their simulations, held-out data or external cohorts. Independent = a separately authored evaluation/benchmark that actually tests the method, not a review or citation. Prospective = a locked model/workflow evaluated prospectively on subsequently accrued observations/outcomes. Retrospective analyses of clinical-trial material do not qualify. Categories can coexist; absence of a verified source is not evidence of absence.
rubric.unknown: not-assessed is displayed as Not established for these fields: sources were checked, but a defensible tier was not established. Unknown values do not match positive filters.
rubric.workflow_caution: A method-level match can combine evidence from different examples or stages. It does not prove all selected properties were demonstrated simultaneously. Read the example notes before shortlisting.
rubric.scope: All 92 included methods were assessed. The 31 contextual/excluded records are outside the candidate browser and are not graded. Public evidence only; no scientific software was installed or executed.
